description: Old logging roads on a south-facing slope offer a gentle ascent/descent. Excellent X-C ski and snowshoe trail. You can also hike or bike in the summer. The easy trail is 4KM long one way.
directions: From Nakusp, drive N on Hwy 23 towards Revelstoke, turnright onto the Hot Springs Road and follow the road for 6 km to the gravel pit access point or 10 KM to the Kuskanax FSR access point.
title: Peter Roulston
